why: The ॑ is the pada-boundary marker; राक्षसो is a normal sandhi form before मुदितमना.
पप्रच्छतुः is the dual perfect agreeing with तौ in the previous line.
परिष्वङ्गो (nominative, 'embrace') is the subject of कृतः; grammatical and metrical.
सुसमाहितैः is instrumental plural agreeing with पुरुषैः.
सुसमाहितौ is dual agreeing with कुमारौ.
सुसमाहिते is a vocative addressed to Ahalya, parallel to सुमध्यमे in the next line.
न्यवेदयन्त is the plural with the subject स्त्रियः of the previous line.
अब्रवीन्मां is correct sandhi of अब्रवीत् माम्.
मुहूर्तेषु is locative plural parallel to नक्षत्रेषु.
यथाविधिः is a nominative in a list of comparisons (जरा, मृत्युः, कालः).
राघवार्थं 'for Raghava's sake' is a normal compound; sense and metre fit.
राघवाद्धि is correct sandhi of राघवात् हि.
वनौकसा is instrumental agreeing with अनेन; correct sandhi before तच्च.
हनूमताक्षे resolves to हनूमता अक्षे, 'when Aksha was slain by Hanuman'.
अब्रवीत्स is the regular sandhi of अब्रवीत् सः.
वनौकसां is genitive plural parallel to त्रिदशोत्तमानाम्.
पतितायां शिलायां is a locative absolute; grammatical.
परवीरघ्नं is accusative agreeing with लक्ष्मणम्.
अब्रवीत्क्व is correct sandhi of अब्रवीत् क्व.
पतितासि is पतिता असि, 'you have fallen', addressed to Rambha.
अब्रवीन्न is correct sandhi of अब्रवीत् न.
निरतु is not a Sanskrit form; the dual निरतौ agreeing with वनौकसौ (and स्वः 'we two are') is required, and the metre still fits.
कृताञ्जलौ is locative absolute with निष्क्रामति पुरुषव्याघ्रे.
कृताञ्जलेः is genitive agreeing with ध्यायतः तस्य प्राङ्मुखस्य.
चतुर्दशे is locative agreeing with दिवसे.
नरश्रेष्ठः is the nominative subject of ययौ.
The ॑ is the pada-boundary marker; प्रतापवान् is sound.
जीवितस्य संशयः 'doubt of life' is correct genitive.
करिष्यामो is the 1st plural with sandhi before दैवेन; fits the speakers.
The ॑ is the pada-boundary marker; समेत्य is sound.
कैकेय्यास्तु is कैकेय्याः तु, genitive with ज्ञातिदासी.
भरतस्तं is भरतः तम्; subject and object both needed by प्रत्युवाच.
दुरात्मनि is locative agreeing with त्वयि.
The ॑ is the pada-boundary marker; जघान is sound.
समागमं is accusative object of जानती.
समागतौ is dual agreeing with मन्त्रिणौ of the next line.
समागतं is accusative object of न्यवेदयन्.
यशस्विनं is accusative agreeing with पार्थिवर्षभम्.
यशस्विना is instrumental agreeing with अनेन (राघवेण).
दशग्रीवे is locative absolute with याते तस्मिन्.
सीतायाश्च is सीतायाः च, genitive parallel to रामस्य.
कर्तुमर्हथ is 2nd plural addressing सुरवराः सर्वे.
The ॑ is the pada-boundary marker; कुम्भकर्णं is sound.
करिष्यतः is the dual future for the two rakshasas Maricha and Subahu.
गमिष्यन् is a future participle agreeing with राघवः.
जीवत्यपि महाराजे is a locative absolute.
महाराजः is the nominative subject of जानाति.
समाहितं is neuter agreeing with यत् स्थितम्.
मुनिपुङ्गवाः is the plural subject of चक्रुः in the previous line.
मुनिपुङ्गवौ is dual for Vishvamitra and Vasishtha, addressed with यदाज्ञापयथः.
नरव्याघ्रो is the nominative subject of ततार.
नरव्याघ्रा (नरव्याघ्राः) is nominative plural with घोराः and श्रुताः.
महर्षये is dative agreeing with वाल्मीकये.
कामरूपिणौ is dual agreeing with राक्षसौ द्वौ.
सागरश्च is सागरः च, nominative with क्रान्तः.
महारथैः is instrumental plural parallel to सहस्रैः.
The ॑ is the pada-boundary marker; महारथः is sound.
The ॑ is the pada-boundary marker; रराज is sound.
महारथाः is nominative plural with ते and ययुः/तस्थुः.
राक्षसाधिपतिः is the nominative subject of ययौ.
